stories.title: Trump Named the Mountain, Tucker Says Nuke, and the Senator Who Called It “Insane” Had a Stroke
stories.excerpt: Tucker Carlson says Trump may nuke a mountain in Iran. I got out the corkboard and tested every dot.

stories.title: Haley Stevens Lost the Primary, Then Lost Her F@#king Mind
stories.excerpt: Two days out, Michigan’s AIPAC favorite endorsed a Trump Republican over a $1,000 internet ad.

stories.title: Your Phone Is Spying On You
stories.excerpt: Claude found thousands of photos my phone took of me without my asking, plus 145,000 I thought I’d deleted.

stories.title: Google Is Kissing Trump’s A$$ So Hard Its AI Forgot Who Won 2020
stories.excerpt: I asked Google’s AI Mode who won the 2020 election. It named Biden, then sent me to the National Archives for homework.

stories.title: ‘Pick Another Protein’ Cindy Hyde-Smith Won’t Debate, but She Will Say Nine Words
stories.excerpt: Hyde-Smith won’t debate, but at Trump’s Corinth rally she delivered a nine-word speech. He called it a record.

stories.title: Microsoft Made $133.7 Billion and Still Wants 60,000 Workers to F@#k Off Quietly
stories.excerpt: Microsoft cleared $133.7 billion in profit and is inviting 60,000 workers to take a voluntary exit before the holidays.
